verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (not a real gosop flag, used for internal templating)

commands.description: List of command configurations to apply; each item must correspond to a supported gosop command and its options

commands[].name.description: Command name; must be one of: 'armor', 'dearmor', 'decrypt', 'encrypt', 'extract-cert', 'generate-key', 'sign', 'verify'

commands[].label.description: For 'armor' command: label for ASCII armor; must be one of: auto, sig, key, cert, message

commands[].session_key_out.description: For 'decrypt' command: output file path for session key

commands[].with_session_key.description: For 'decrypt' command: session key to use for decryption

commands[].with_password.description: For 'decrypt' and 'encrypt' commands: password for encryption/decryption

commands[].verify_out.description: For 'decrypt' command: output file path for verification results

commands[].verify_with.description: For 'decrypt' command: list of certificate files or IDs to use for verification

commands[].verify_not_before.description: For 'decrypt' command: earliest date for certificate validity (format: - or YYYY-MM-DD)

commands[].verify_not_after.description: For 'decrypt' command: latest date for certificate validity (format: - or YYYY-MM-DD)

commands[].as_value.description: For 'encrypt' command: output mode; must be one of: binary, text

commands[].no_armor.description: For 'encrypt', 'extract-cert', 'generate-key', 'sign' commands: disable ASCII armor output

commands[].sign_with.description: For 'encrypt' command: secret key to use for signing

commands[].not_before.description: For 'verify' command: earliest date for certificate validity (format: - or YYYY-MM-DD)

commands[].not_after.description: For 'verify' command: latest date for certificate validity (format: - or YYYY-MM-DD)
